stages.title: Play the story
stages.summary: Play through Chapters 1 to 5 in order while taking optional side missions as they appear. Make sure to complete the Chapter 1 balcony meditation for the missable Positive Mental Attitude trophy early. Keep manual saves at the start and end of each chapter since there is no mission replay feature.
trophy_names: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
stages.tip: Remember that cheats disable both trophies and game saving.

stages.title: The 100% Completion checklist
stages.summary: After finishing the story, access the 100% Completion tracker under Progress and Stats in the pause menu. Work systematically through optional missions, vehicle scans, animal studies, stunt jumps, and challenges. Nothing in this stage is missable, so you can complete them at your own leisure in free-roam.
stages.tip: Check your progress regularly via the in-game checklist stats.

stages.title: Strangers & Freaks and cleanup
stages.summary: Finish all remaining stranger strands, character questlines, and final collectibles or activity cleanups across Leonida. Tackle any remaining open-world activities and specific unmarked tasks. Once finished, you will be fully prepared for the final platinum sweep.
stages.tip: Note that three trophies have unverified methods yet are tracked openly.
